quizName: DMV Practice Test #2 15 Questions • Passing Score 12

questions.question: Which surface does NOT have poor traction?
questions.explanation: Several surfaces have poor traction for tires. These include wet pavement, loose gravel, sand, mud, snow, ice, and painted lane markings. Dry pavement provides the best traction.

questions.question: A person convicted of DUI may receive any of the following sentences, EXCEPT:

options.text: Installation of a breath-alcohol device in their vehicle.

questions.explanation: DUI penalties in Illinois include license suspension, a breath-alcohol device installed in your vehicle, large fines, and community service. A simple warning is not given.

questions.question: How many alcoholic drinks does the body eliminate per hour?
questions.explanation: On average, your body eliminates about one drink per hour. The time needed to lower your blood alcohol content (BAC) varies. The safest choice is not to drive after drinking any alcohol.

questions.question: When riding at night, you should travel:

options.text: More slowly than during the day with similar conditions.
At the same speed as during the day with similar conditions.
Faster than during the day with similar conditions.
On the road shoulder so other vehicles can see you.

questions.correctAnswerText: More slowly than during the day with similar conditions.
questions.explanation: Ride at a slower speed at night than you would during the day under similar weather and traffic conditions. It is harder to see hazards in the dark, so slowing down helps you avoid accidents.

questions.question: In Illinois, motorcycle safety helmets are:

options.text: Required for both operator and passenger.

questions.explanation: Illinois law does not require motorcycle helmets. However, wearing a properly-fitted helmet is strongly recommended for safety.

questions.question: The best way to stop quickly is to use both brakes.
questions.explanation: To stop quickly, apply both the front and rear brakes at the same time.

questions.question: If you wait one hour after having one alcoholic drink:

options.text: You cannot be arrested for drinking and driving.
Your riding skills will not be affected.
Effects from the alcohol may still remain.
You will be fine as long as you ride slowly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Effects from the alcohol may still remain.
questions.explanation: Your body eliminates about one drink per hour on average. However, alcohol can still build up in your system even if you have one drink per hour. This buildup can affect your ability to ride safely.

questions.question: Motorcycle passengers must wear a helmet.
questions.explanation: Helmets greatly reduce the risk of fatal head injuries in a crash, but Illinois law does not require them.

questions.question: The front brake is:

options.text: Only for emergency use if the rear brake fails.

questions.explanation: The front brake is safe when used correctly. It is more powerful than the rear brake and provides at least three-fourths of the total stopping power.

questions.question: Which is NOT important when choosing a motorcycle helmet?

options.text: The helmet meets U.S. Department of Transportation standards.
The helmet fits snugly all the way around your head.
The helmet has no defects, such as cracks or loose padding.

questions.explanation: Choose a helmet that meets U.S. DOT and state standards, fits snugly all the way around your head, and has no visible defects such as cracks, loose padding, or frayed straps.

questions.question: Brightly-colored helmets:

options.text: Help others see you more easily.
Don't improve how visible you are.

questions.correctAnswerText: Help others see you more easily.
questions.explanation: Bright helmets are a good choice. They protect your head in a crash and help other drivers see you on the road.

questions.question: A plastic, shatter-resistant face shield:

options.text: Is not needed if you have a windshield.

questions.explanation: A plastic, shatter-resistant face shield protects your whole face in a crash. Goggles only protect your eyes. A windshield is not a good replacement for goggles or a face shield.

questions.question: The best way to stop quickly is to:

options.text: Release the throttle and use the front brake.
Use both brakes at the same time.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use both brakes at the same time.
questions.explanation: To stop quickly, press both brakes at the same time. Apply firm pressure and don't panic if the brakes lock.

questions.question: Reflective clothing should:

options.text: Be worn only during the day.

questions.explanation: Bright and reflective clothing helps others see you in all conditions. Most motorcycle crashes happen during the day, so wear bright clothing anytime you ride.

questions.question: Which fabric gives the best protection for motorcycle riders?
questions.explanation: Leather jackets and pants offer the most protection for motorcycle riders.
